Specified using inches as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per yard)
Specified using millilitre or litre or fluid ounces as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per litre/pint diluted drink).
Specified using grams, kilograms, or ounces as unitOfMeasure (allows calculation of price per kilogram/pound prepared food).

values.label: Initial Load
values.definition: The sending of pricing information for the first time.

values.label: Reload
values.definition: Sending all current and known CURRENT pricing. This is used to start over by replacing previously synchronised information.

values.label: Resend
values.definition: Indicates that the message is used to recover a lost or missing message.

values.label: Restart
values.definition: The status used when a data recipient had rejected an item's pricing but wishes to resume price synchronisation.

values.label: Resynchronisation of All Price Types
values.definition: Resynchronisation of all Price Types for pricing done at the lowest level consumer unit. Uses NO_ACTION code to differentiate price types that have changed from those that have not.

values.label: Allowance
values.definition: Credit reflected on an invoice.  This can occur either at the item or the invoice level. There are many types of allowances. Some are contractually based, e.g. backhaul, others are not formalized contracts. Some allowances are offered to the industry such as payment terms while others such as promotional allowances are trading partner specific.

values.label: Bracket Tier Price
values.definition: The price associated with an item for the purchase of a specific number of trade items, or some other logistical measure (weight, cube, truck). These are often offered in a series (e.g. 100 to 299 case lots, 300 to 599, full truckload, half truckload; each offering a different discount).

values.label: Charge
values.definition: Debit reflected on an invoice.  This can occur either at the item or at the invoice level. There are many types of charges. Some are contractually based, others are not formalized contracts.

values.label: Contract Price
values.definition: The price associated with an item that has been negotiated or agreed to between trading partners exclusive of taxes but inclusive of allowances, charges and customs duty where applicable. This price would typically be associated with a formal contract between trading partners.

values.label: Declared Customs Value
values.definition: This is the value of the item as declared by the supplier. This value is used by customs to calculate the customs duty that is payable.

values.label: Introductory Price
values.definition: Not Available

values.label: List Price
values.definition: External price associated with a product absent of all allowances or charges. This is normally the printed price contained on supplier’s price list or catalogue. (May or may not be customer specific).

values.label: Other
values.definition: An unspecified type.

values.label: Promotional Price
values.definition: A price that is available only as part of a promotion.

values.label: Retail Price
values.definition: The retail (to consumer) price as suggested by the manufacturer. May or may not appear on the package.

values.label: Transaction Price
values.definition: The line item/GTIN price shown on the invoice document, including allowances and/or charges applying to the trading partner relationship (which can be zero), but excluding VAT and any other taxes, fees, and/or duties.

values.label: Transaction Price With Special Taxes
values.definition: The line item / GTIN price shown on the invoice document, including allowances and/ or charges applying to the trading partner relationship (which can be zero),  excluding VAT, but including any other taxes, fees, and/or duties.

values.label: Transaction price with special taxes and early payment discount
values.definition: A specific financial allowance, comprising special taxes, whose goal is to identify a special price type and price value that the data recipient would pay to the data provider IF it pays the invoice in a certain delay (such delay is previously negotiated between the dataProvider and the dataRecipient and does not have to be communicated with the tariff)

values.label: Transaction Price With VAT and Special Taxes
values.definition: The line item / GTIN price shown on the invoice document, including allowances and/ or charges applying to the trading partner relationship (which can be zero), including both VAT and any other taxes, fees, and/or duties.

values.label: Transaction price with VAT and special taxes and early payment discount
values.definition: A specific financial allowance, comprising VAT and special taxes, whose goal is to identify a special price type and price value that the data recipient would pay to the data provider IF it pays the invoice in a certain delay (such delay is previously negotiated between the dataProvider and the dataRecipient and does not have to be communicated with the tariff)

values.label: Underbond List Price
values.definition: The price associated with an item exclusive of all allowances, charges, taxes and customs duty. (May or may not be customer specific). This applies to imported items that upon arrival into the country are stored in a Customs bonded warehouse. The goods are then sold without the customs duty paid. The purchaser must pay the customs duty.

values.label: Underbond Transaction Price
values.definition: The price associated with an item exclusive of all taxes and customs duty but inclusive of all allowances and charges. This applies to imported items that upon arrival into the country are stored in a Customs bonded warehouse. The goods are then sold without the customs duty paid. The purchaser must pay the customs duty.

values.label: Monetary Amount
values.definition: An amount of or relating to money.

values.label: Percent
values.definition: One part in a hundred.

deprecated_values.label: Fruit
deprecated_values.definition: The product has an added ingredient that causes the flavour of fruit.

deprecated_values.label: Nut
deprecated_values.definition: The product has an added ingredient that causes the flavour of nut.

deprecated_values.label: Other
deprecated_values.definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.

deprecated_values.label: Salt
deprecated_values.definition: The product has an added ingredient that causes the flavour of salt.

deprecated_values.label: Sugar
deprecated_values.definition: The product has an added ingredient that causes the flavour of sugar.

values.label: Data Synchronisation
values.definition: The process of continuous harmonisation of information between all trading partners ensures that the master data is the same in all trading partners systems.

values.label: Item Authorisation
values.definition: The act of granting permission to sell (or deliver) an item at a specific location or groups of locations where the authorisation could be triggered by either trading partner depending on the buying and selling relationship through GDSN.

values.label: Item Futurisation
values.definition: The process framework for communicating information related to CURRENT trade item version information using the Global Data Synchronisation Network (GDSN).

values.label: Party Synchronisation
values.definition: The process of synchronising party Master Data through GDSN.

values.label: Price Synchronisation
values.definition: The process of synchronising price information through GDSN.

values.label: Almost Seedless
values.definition: Item contains significantly less than normal mature seeds for this particular variety. Some mature seeds will exist in trade item. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines.

values.label: Seedless
values.definition: Item contains No mature Seeds or potentially a few errant seeds. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines.

values.label: Seeds
values.definition: Item contains the normal amount of mature seeds which are typical for this trade item. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines.

values.label: Unidentified
values.definition: Quantity or presence of seeds not determined

values.label: Assembly
values.definition: Country where product is assembled.

values.label: Birth
values.definition: The place the animal was born/hatched. The place may be a country, region (land or sea), city, etc. The actual birth place of a particular animal would be transactional. Note: the term animal includes but is not limited to mammals, birds, fish and crustaceans.

values.label: Bottling
values.definition: The place in which the beverage is bottled.

values.label: Catch zone
values.definition: The sea zone in which the seafood in the trade item was caught.

values.label: Cutter
values.definition: The place where the cutting operation on the carcass or group of carcasses is performed. e.g. approval number of the cutting hall acc. to Regulation EC No 1760/2000 of the European Parliament. Note: The animal is not killed at this location.

values.label: Dyeing
values.definition: The place where the product is coloured using dyes.

values.label: Farming
values.definition: The cultivation of animals, plants, fungi, and other life forms

values.label: Finishing
values.definition: The place where the product undergoes final treatments to enhance its quality, appearance, or performance.

values.label: Garment making
values.definition: The place where the product is cut, assembled, and sewn into its final form.

values.label: Hunted/Gathered
values.definition: The place where wild animals may be hunted/trapped/caught or where wild vegetation may be gathered/harvested/picked.

values.label: Importation
values.definition: The country from where the trade item has been purchased by the importer.  This is different than the “Last Processing” the product is somehow altered, prepared or assembled before it is imported. Example: a case of 12 bottles of wine is made in France (Country of Origin = France), and a Canadian company purchased/ imported the same case from Italy (Country of Import = Italy)

values.label: Last processing
values.definition: The ISO 3166-1 code that identifies the country in which the trade item was last processed and tested before importation.

values.label: Milking
values.definition: Milking is the act of removing milk from mammary glands of various animal types.

values.label: Mounting
values.definition: The place where components, embellishments, or accessories are attached to the product during production.

values.label: Printing
values.definition: The place where patterns, graphics, or text are applied to the product.

values.label: Rearing
values.definition: The place the animal was raised after birth to the end of the animals’ life. The place may be a country, region (land or sea), city, etc.  The actual rearing place(s) of a particular animal would be transactional. Guidance: If the animal was raised in multiple locations, one instance of the attribute should be populated (e.g. reared in Spain and Portugal). If the animal may have been raised in a single location but for a particular animal it is transactional, it is suggested to populate the attribute for each possibility of location an animal may have come from (e.g. Instance 1 - reared in Spain, instance 2 - Reared in Portugal). Note: the term animal includes but is not limited to mammals, birds, fish and crustaceans.

values.label: Slaughter
values.definition: The place the animal was killed to be processed for food or other purposes. The place may be a country, region (land or sea), city, etc. The actual slaughter place of a particular animal would be transactional. Note: the term animal includes but is not limited to mammals, birds, fish and crustaceans.

values.label: Stitching
values.definition: The place where parts of the product are joined using stitching or sewing techniques.

values.label: Weaving/Knitting
values.definition: The place where the product is formed through weaving or knitting processes.

values.label: Fuel Quality Recommended
values.definition: Describes the quality of the fuel used to give the best performance and upkeep of the product. Use productCharacteristicValueString to populate.

values.label: Fuel System
values.definition: Describes the type of fuel system the motor has. Examples: Digital Fuel Injection (DFI®) with 60mm throttle body; Fuel Stratified Injection (FSI). Use productCharacteristicValueDescription to populate.

values.label: Transmission Type
values.definition: Designation of the type of transmission Examples 6MT (6 speed manual transmission) 4WD (4 wheel drive), Automatic. Use  productCharacteristicValueString to populate.

values.label: Air Speed Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum air speed, e.g. leaf blower or fan. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Amperage Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximal amperage.  Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Apparel Bag Type Code
values.definition: Indicators of different types of lightweight, flexible container that may be closed for holding, storing, carrying an item or articles. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate. Values are available in GS1 code list: ApparelBagTypeCode.

values.label: Area Performance M2 Per Hour Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum area performance measured in squaremeter per hour (m²/h). Populate using productCharacteristicValueInteger.

values.label: Ballast Factor
values.definition: Is the measured ability of a particular ballast to produce light from the lamp(s) it powers. The ballast factor itself is derived by dividing the lumen output of a particular lamp-ballast combination by the lumen output of the same lamp(s) on a reference ballast. This factor, which usually results in a number less than one, accounts for the fact that some lumen loss results when operating lamps on commercially available ballasts. Populate using productCharacteristicValueNumeric.

values.label: Bears National Symbol
values.definition: Indication whether or not the trade item or trade item packaging bears an image of a national symbol of the target market (e.g. flag or coat of arms). The importation of such goods may be restricted by local target market regulations. Populate using productCharacteristicValueCode "true" or "false".

values.label: Bedding Type Code
values.definition: Indicators for different bedclothes; blankets, sheets, etc., used on a bed. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate. Values are available in GS1 code list: BeddingTypeCode.

values.label: Bill Logo Application Type Code
values.definition: Indicator of the different applications to a hat bill. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate. Values are available in GS1 code list: BillLogoApplicationTypeCode.

values.label: Birthstone Month
values.definition: The month that the gem is representative of and gem type for example: April-Diamond; August- Peridot; December-Tanzanite, Zircon, Turquoise; February- methyst; January- Garnet; July- Ruby; June - Pearl, Alexandrite; March- Aquamarine; May- Emerald; November- Topaz, Citrine; October- Tourmaline, Opal; September- Sapphire. Use productCharacteristicValueDescription to populate.

values.label: Blade Type
values.definition: Describes the characteristics of the blade like Serrated, single edge. Populate using  productCharacteristicValueDescription.

values.label: Boot Shaft Type Code
values.definition: Indicator that is used to identify the style height of a boot. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate. Values are available in GS1 code list: BootShaftTypeCode.

values.label: Bracelet Type Code
values.definition: Indicator of the construction or style of a bracelet. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate. Values are available in GS1 code list: BraceletTypeCode.

values.label: CPU Socket Type
values.definition: Type of mechanical slot that the CPU is compatible with.  Examples: AM3; LGA 1150. Use  productCharacteristicValueString to populate value.

values.label: Cable Length
values.definition: The total length of the cable (including connectors). Use productCharacteristicValueMeasurement to populate value.

values.label: Calendar Date Format Code
values.definition: Describes the format the calendar is using for example HOURLY, DAILY, MONTHLY, YEARLY. Uses productCharacteristicValueCode to populate with values from CalendarDateFormatTypeCode.

values.label: Calendar Term
values.definition: The length of the calendar for the item examples 12 months, 14 months, 16 months, 2 years. Use productCharacteristicValueMeasurement to populate.

values.label: Camera Facing Code
values.definition: A camera on the rear of the trade item, facing away from the user. FRONT_FACING or REAR_FACING.  Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate value.

values.label: Car Seat LATCH System
values.definition:
Designates whether or not the trade item has a car seat LATCH system. The LATCH (Lower Anchors and Tethers for Children) system was developed to make it easier to correctly install child safety seats without using seat belts.
TRUE, FALSE, UNSPECIFIED, NOT_APPLICABLE.  Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate value.

values.label: Car Seat Type
values.definition: Describes the type of car seat convertible, booster, travel, rear facing, front facing. Use productCharacteristicValueDescription to populate value.

values.label: Catch Volume Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum catch volume, e.g. catch tray of a lawn mower. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Chain Speed Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum chain speed, e.g. chainsaw. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Chuck Type
values.definition: The type of drill chuck — the part that holds the bit. Examples SDS; Keyed. Populate using productCharacteristicValueDescription.

values.label: Coat Jacket Type Code
values.definition: Indicator that is used to identify the cut or style pertaining to the Coat/Jacket. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate. Values are available in GS1 code list: CoatJacketTypeCode.

values.label: Colour Rendering Index Min
values.definition:
Indicates the minimum colour rendering index, e.g. lamps. A colour rendering index (CRI) is a quantitative measure of the ability of a light source to reveal the colours of various objects faithfully in comparison with an ideal or natural light source. Light sources with a high CRI are desirable in colour-critical applications such as neonatal care, photography and cinematography. It is defined by the International Commission on Illumination (CIE) as follows:
Colour rendering: Effect of an illuminant on the colour appearance of objects by conscious or subconscious comparison with their colour appearance under a reference illuminant.
Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Compression Ratio
values.definition: When the piston has moved up to the top of its stroke inside the cylinder, and the remaining volume inside the head or combustion chamber has been reduced to 100 cc, then the compression ratio would be proportionally described as 1000:100, or with fractional reduction, a 10:1 compression ratio. Examples 8.2:1; 9.0:1 productCharacteristicValueString

values.label: Computer Form Factor
values.definition: Commonly used term for the physical size to which the computer conforms. Example: Tower; Micro Tower; Nettop. Use  productCharacteristicValueString to populate value.

values.label: Computer Graphics Information
values.definition: Basic graphics processor or graphics card information. Example AMD Radeon HD 6410D; Nividia GTX 8600. Use productCharacteristicValueString to populate value.

values.label: Contains Plant Material
values.definition: Indication whether or not the trade item contains plant material. The importation of such goods may be restricted by local target market regulations. Populate using productCharacteristicValueCode "true" or "false".

values.label: Contains Timber
values.definition: Indication whether or not the trade item contains timber/wood/MDF. The importation of such goods may be restricted by local target market regulations. Populate using productCharacteristicValueCode "true" or "false".

values.label: Cooling System Type
values.definition: Describes the type of cooling system the trade item has. Examples Air, Liquid, Inducted Water. Use productCharacteristicValueDescription to populate,

values.label: Display Screen Response Time
values.definition: The amount of time the pixels in the display take to change from one state to another. Measured in milliseconds. Use productCharacteristicValueIMeasurement to populate value.

values.label: Distributed Load Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum distributed load, e.g. tent or small summer house in the garden. Many loads do not act as point loads, but instead act over an extended length or area as distributed loads. For example, a tractor with continuous tracks will apply a load distributed over the length of each track. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Document Feeder Type Code
values.definition: Does the imaging device incorporate an automatic document feeder or manual MANUAL; AUTOMATIC.  Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate value.

values.label: Does Trade Item Have Empty Fuel Container
values.definition: Does the trade item have an empty Fuel container that may be filled with fuels such as gas, CO2, Propane, ETC. as these types of containers must meet regulatory guidelines. Example: TRUE, FALSE.  Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate value.

values.label: Drivetrain Type
values.definition: The system in a motor vehicle that connects the transmission to the drive axles. Examples: T-V-Drive Cummins QSB 425 Diesels; 160mm jet pump, axial-flow, single stage. Use productCharacteristicValueString to populate.

values.label: Drying Time
values.definition: The amount of time the trade item takes to be cured, dried properly before ready for use or touch. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Engine Displacement
values.definition: Engine displacement is the volume swept by all the pistons inside the cylinders of a reciprocating engine in a single movement from top dead centre (TDC) to bottom dead centre (BDC). Populate using productCharacteristicsValuemeasurement.

values.label: Engine Location
values.definition: Inboard, Outboard, Front, rear, Inboard & Outboard. Populate using productCharacteristicValueDescription.

values.label: Engine Model
values.definition: The type of engine that comes with the trade item. Examples: 2.0L EcoBoost; 12-cylinder 6-litre Continental. Populate using productCharacteristicValueString.

values.label: Engine Start Method Type
values.definition: The method of how the engine starts. Example Pull Cord, Electric Button, Key, etc. Populate using productCharacteristicValueDescription.

values.label: Expenditure of Force Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum expenditure of force e.g. drill press stand. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Faucet Drilling Setting
values.definition: The location of how the faucet setting are aligned for installation. Examples Centre-set; Widespread. Use productCharacteristicValueDescription.

values.label: Firearm Calibre
values.definition: Calibre or calibre is the approximate internal diameter of the barrel, or the diameter of the projectile it fires, usually shown in millimetres, or in hundredths or thousandths of an inch. Populate using  productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Firearm Gauge
values.definition: The gauge refers indirectly to the bore diameter of a shotgun. It is not a direct measure, but is calculated as the number of lead balls of a bore diameter required to make up one pound. This is an old British measurement system. Thus, a 16-gauge shotgun has a bore diameter such that 16 lead balls of the bore diameter would weigh a pound. Populate using productCharacteristicValueNumeric.

values.label: Firmness
values.definition: The product's level of firmness as it is described from a marketing perspective. Example: Plush, soft, firm. Use productCharacteristicValueDescription.

values.label: Flour Type
values.definition: Indicates the Flour Type number. (e.g. The German flour type numbers (Mehltypen) indicate the amount of ash - unburned mineral content, measured in milligrams - obtained from 100g of the dry mass of this flour; the French flour type  numbers indicate the ash content (in milligrams) per 10g flour)

values.label: Flow Rate Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum flow rate, e.g. pumps. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Focal Length
values.definition: The basic description of a photographic lens. It is not a measurement of the actual length of a lens, but a calculation of an optical distance from the point where light rays converge to form a sharp image of an object to the digital sensor or 35mm film at the focal plane in the camera. The focal length of a lens is determined when the lens is focused at infinity. Both the minimum and maximum focal lengths are stated for example 15-80 millimetres. Use productCharacteristicValueString to populate.

values.label: Focal Ratio
values.definition: In optics, the f-number (sometimes called focal ratio, f-ratio, f-stop, or relative aperture) of an optical system is the ratio of the lens's focal length to the diameter of the entrance pupil. Examples include f/2.5, f/3.8. Use productCharacteristicValueString to populate.

values.label: Front Brakes Type
values.definition: The type of brakes that recommended. For the front of vehicle. example: Ventilated 13" discs with dual piston callipers; Twin Brembo 320mm fully-floating high carbon stainless steel discs & Brembo 4 piston radially mounted callipers. Brembo front brake master cylinder with integral reservoir. Use productCharacteristicValueDescription to populate.

values.label: Front Suspension Type
values.definition: The type of suspension that recommended. For the front of vehicle. example: independent MacPherson strut-type with rear stabilizer bar; Inverted strut-type with aluminium-alloy lower L-arm and pillow-ball joint mount, stabilizer bar; Ohlin's 43mm upside down forks with adjustable preload, compression & rebound damping. Use productCharacteristicValueDescription to populate.

values.label: Fuse Quantity Max
values.definition: Indicate the maximum number of fuses. Populate using productCharacteristicValueInteger.

values.label: Has Removable Flash
values.definition:
Determines whether the trade item contains a flash.
TRUE, FALSE, UNSPECIFIED, NOT_APPLICABLE.  Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate value. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate value.

values.label: Has Signal Booster
values.definition: Denotes if item has a signal booster, is a bidirectional amplifier created to boost weak cell phone signals in remote or hard to reach areas. TRUE, FALSE, UNSPECIFIED, NOT_APPLICABLE.  Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate value.

values.label: Hat Bill Type Code
values.definition: Indicator of the shape or form of the front part of a cap that shades the wearer's face from sunlight. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate. Values are available in GS1 code list: BillTypeCode.

values.label: Heating Element
values.definition: A heating element converts electricity into heat through the process of resistive or Joule heating. Electric current passing through the element .encounters resistance, resulting in heating of the element. Use productCharacteristicsValueDescription.

values.label: Hitch Class
values.definition: Trailer hitches are given a class rating based on their maximum weight capacity and receiver opening size. The classes range from class I, which has the lowest capacity, to class V, which has the highest capacity. Use productCharacteristicValueString to populate.

values.label: Idling Speed Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum idling speed. Idle speed (idling, or idle) is the rotational speed the engine runs on when the engine is uncoupled to the drivetrain and the throttle pedal isn't depressed (generally measured in revolutions per minute, or rpm, of the crankshaft) of a combustion engine. At idle speed, the engine generates enough power to run reasonably smoothly and operate its ancillaries (water pump, alternator, and, if equipped, other accessories such as power steering), but usually not enough to perform useful work, such as moving an automobile. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Idling Speed Min
values.definition: Indicates the minimum idling speed. Idle speed (idling, or idle) is the rotational speed the engine runs on when the engine is uncoupled to the drivetrain and the throttle pedal isn't depressed (generally measured in revolutions per minute, or rpm, of the crankshaft) of a combustion engine. At idle speed, the engine generates enough power to run reasonably smoothly and operate its ancillaries (water pump, alternator, and, if equipped, other accessories such as power steering), but usually not enough to perform useful work, such as moving an automobile. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Impact Energy Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum impact energy, e.g. rotary hammer. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Impeller Or Propeller Type
values.definition: Describes the type of propeller. Examples: Three-blade, oval-edge stainless steel; Aluminium 3 blade, 8" Diameter, 7" Pitch, Standard Rotation. Use productCharacteristicValueDescription to populate.

values.label: Induction System Type
values.definition: The system that brings the fuel-air mixture to the cylinders . It includes the carburettor or fuel injection system, intake manifold , intake ports , and intake valves . Example: Eaton Twin Vortices Series Roots-type supercharger with air-to-water intercooler. Use productCharacteristicValueString to populate.

values.label: Inner Flesh Colour Code
values.definition: The colour of the inner flesh usually edible part of a fruit or vegetable. Examples are pink or yellow grapefruit, orange or green for a melon. Use values PINK, YELLOW, GREEN, GREEN_WHITE, RED, WHITE, ORANGE, BROWN, BLACK, VIOLET, PURPLE and then use GPC colour code list to broaden colour code.  Use ProductCharacteristicValueCode to populate based on values in InnerFleshColourCode.

values.label: Is Bare Tool
values.definition:
Is bare tool means you can buy the tool minus the battery and swap the battery out between the tools. Batteries and chargers are sold separately.
TRUE, FALSE Populate using productCharacteristicValueCode.

values.label: Is Maternity
values.definition: Indicates, with reference to the product branding, labelling or packaging, the descriptive term that is used by the product manufacturer to identify if the product is intended as maternity wear.

values.label: Jean Characteristic
values.definition: Specifies the wash and or treatment the jeans have undertaken as part of the production process ex. Stone Wash, worn look, torn, Acid, Dirty, Vintage, etc. Use productCharacteristicValueDescription to populate value.

values.label: Limit Load
values.definition: Indicates the maximum Limit load. Limit load is the maximum load that a structure can safely carry. It's the load at which the structure is in a state of incipient plastic collapse. As the load on the structure increases, the displacements increases linearly in the elastic range till the load attains the yield value. Beyond this, the load-displacement response becomes non-linear and the plastic or irreversible part of the displacement increases steadily with the applied load. Plasticity spreads throughout the solid and at the limit load, the plastic zone becomes very large and the displacements become unbounded and the component is said to have collapsed. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Load Weight Capacity Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum load weight capacity, e.g. plastic step ladder. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Load Weight Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum load weight (duty rating), e.g. ladder, shelf. Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Load Weight Per Wood Beam Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximum load weight per wood beam (balk, wood truss). Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Lock Mechanism Type
values.definition: The type of locking mechanism the item has. Examples Padlock & Key, Combination Lock, Trunk Lock, Case Locking Catch, etc. Use productCharacteristicValueDescription to populate.

values.label: Maximum Aperature Value
values.definition: The maximum size a hole or an opening through which light travels in the trade item for example  f22 (f/22),16 (f/16), f/11, f/8.0, f/5.6, f/4.0, f/2.8, f/2.0, f/1.8. Use  productCharacteristicValueString to populate.

values.label: Maximum Document Size Capability
values.definition: The maximum document size that the imaging device is capable of handling. Examples A0, A4, Letter. Use productCharacteristicValueString to populate value.

values.label: Maximum Engine Power
values.definition: The amount of power an engine can produce. Examples like cars, boats, etc. Usually some units measures are horsepower or kilowatts per hour etc.

values.label: Maximum Incline
values.definition: The angle of incline the item can be raised at maximum. Populate using productCharacteristicValueNumeric.

values.label: Maximum Inflation Pressure
values.definition: The maximum pressure the trade item should be inflated. Use productCharacteristicValueMeasurement to populate.

values.label: Maximum Shutter Speed
values.definition: The maximum measurement of time that a camera's shutter is open—allowing light, usually after it has passed through a lens and through the aperture diaphragm, to strike a photosensitive surface, like film or a digital sensor. For example, 0025 seconds. Use  productCharacteristicValueMeasurement to populate.

values.label: Maximum Speed

Varieties are recognised for their unique characteristics by authorities for variety protection. They may have been derived by mutation or hybridization

values.label: Surface Feet Max
values.definition: Indicates the maximal speed (surface feet)/orbits per minute, e.g.. belt sander. Surface feet per minute (SFPM or SFM) is an imperial and American customary unit of speed, being the number of linear feet that a location on a rotating component travels in one minute. Its most common use is in the measurement of cutting speed (surface speed) in machining. It is a unit of velocity that describes how fast the cutting edge of the cutting tool travels. It correlates directly to the machinability of the work piece material and the hardness of the cutting tool material. It relates to spindle speed via variables such as cutter diameter (for rotating cutters) or work piece diameter (for lathe work). Populate using productCharacteristicValueMeasurement.

values.label: Thrust

Torque, moment, or moment of force is the tendency of a force to rotate an object about an axis, fulcrum, or pivot. Just as a force is a push or a pull, a torque can be thought of as a twist to an object. Mathematically, torque is defined as the cross product of the position vector of the point where the force is applied (distance vector) and the force vector, which tends to produce rotation. Populate using productCharacteristicValueInteger.

Some of the codes are very detailed and were considered to be more informational, rather than what is used in GPC for grouping products together. The load index on a tyre is a numerical code stipulating the maximum load (mass, or weight) each tyre can carry.  Load value codes range from 0 to 279.  These codes correspond the maximum weight the tyre is designed for.  For example, Code 60 means the tyre can carry a load of 250 kg (550 lb).  The Load Index tables can be found on numerous internet sites. Use productCharacteristicValueCode to populate value.

Temperature resistance is given one of the following grades, which you will find on the sidewall of your tire: A, B, C. Examples in US Tires graded A effectively dissipate heat up to a maximum speed that is greater than 115 mph. Tires graded B effectively dissipate heat at a speed range between 100 mph and 115 mph. Tires graded C effectively dissipate heat at a speed range between 85 mph and 100 mph. Populate using productCharacteristicsValueCode.

values.label: International Dysphagia Diet Standardisation Initiative
values.definition: International Dysphagia Diet Standardisation Initiative (IDDSI) develops a standardised  terminology and definitions to describe texture modified foods and thickened liquids used for individuals with dysphagia of all ages, in care settings, and for all cultures. https://iddsi.org/

values.label: Thin
values.definition: Liquids that flow like water and can flow through a straw or teat/nipple.

values.label: Slightly thick
values.definition: Liquids that are thicker than water and can flow through a straw.

values.label: Mildly thick
values.definition: Liquids that are sippable and pour quickly from spoon but slower than thin drinks and slightly thick drinks.

values.label: Liquidised
values.definition: Liquidised food that can be eaten with a spoon or drunk from a cup. It has a smooth texture with no "bit" (lumps, fibers, husk, bits of shell or skin, particles of gristle or bone).

values.label: Moderately thick
values.definition: Liquids that can be drunk from a cup or taken with a spoon. Need some effort to drink them through a wide diameter straw and have smooth texture with no lumps, fibers or seeds.

values.label: Extremely thick
values.definition: Extremely thick liquids that are usually eaten with a spoon and cannot be drunk from a cup or sucked through a straw. Have a smooth texture with no lumps and hold shape on a spoon.

values.label: Pureed
values.definition: Foods that are usually eaten with a spoon, don't require chewing and liquid (like sauces) must not separate from solids.

values.label: Minced & moist minced
values.definition: Foods that are soft and moist, but no liquid leaking/dripping from the food, biting is not required, and minimal chewing required. Lumps of 4mm in size and can be mashed with the tongue.

values.label: Soft & bite sized
values.definition: Foods that are soft, tender and moist, but no thin liquid leaking/dripping from the food, ability to "bite off" a piece of food is not required. Bite-sized pieces no bigger than 1.5cm x 1.5cm in size. Food can be mashed/broken down with pressure from fork.

values.label: Easy to chew
values.definition: Normal, everyday foods of soft/tender textures that are developmentally and age appropriate. Any method may be used to eat these foods.

values.label: Regular
values.definition: Normal, everyday foods of various textures that are developmentally and age appropriate. Any method may be used to eat these foods and the food may be hard and crunchy or naturally soft.

deprecated_values.definition: Note: This code will be deleted in a future release. Foods that are normal, everyday food of various textures that are developmentally and age appropriate.
