values.definition: Mild to moderate use of profanity.

values.label: Lyrics Lyrics
values.definition: Mild references to profanity, sexuality, violence, alcohol, or drug use in music.
Depictions or dialogue involving "adult" humour, including sexual references.
Mild scenes depicting characters in unsafe and/or violent situations.

values.label: Nudity Nudity
values.definition: Graphic or prolonged depictions of nudity.
Brief and/or mild depictions of nudity.
Player can gamble, including betting or wagering real cash or currency.
Mild to moderate sexual references and/or depictions. May include partial nudity.
Depictions of rape or other sexual acts.
Player can gamble without betting or wagering real cash or currency.
Intended for very young ages.
Explicit and/or frequent use of profanity.
Explicit and/or frequent references to profanity, sex, violence, alcohol, or drug use in music.
Graphic references to and/or depictions of sexual behaviour, possibly including nudity.
Mild provocative references or materials.
Reference to and/or images of tobacco products.
The consumption of alcoholic beverages.
The consumption or use of illegal drugs.
The consumption of tobacco products.

values.label: Violence Violence
values.definition: Scenes involving aggressive conflict.

values.label: Music El
values.definition: Explicit Lyrics

values.label: Bad Language
values.definition: Contains bad language including mild swearing or offensive language in games rated 12, or blasphemy and sexual expletives in games rated 16 or 18.

values.label: Discrimination Discrimination
values.definition: Game contains depictions of, or material which may encourage discrimination games rated 18 containing depictions of ethnic, religious, nationalistic of other stereotypes that could encourage hatred.

values.label: Drugs Drugs
values.definition: Game refers to or depicts the use of drugs encourages the use of tobacco or alcohol in games rated 16 or depict illegal drugs in 18-rated titles

values.label: Fear Fear
values.definition: Game may be frightening or scary for young children contains images or sounds that could be frightening to young children

values.label: Gambling Gambling
values.definition: Game that encourages or teaches gambling games rated 12, 16 or 18 that may encourage or teach gambling for money normally played in casinos, gambling halls, racetracks, etc.

values.label: Online Online
values.definition: Game can be played online with or against other players

values.label: Sex Sex
values.definition: Game depicts nudity and/or sexual behaviour or sexual references ranging from obvious sexual innuendo to explicit images of sexual activity

values.label: Violence Violence
values.definition: Game contains depictions of violence rangeing from cartoon-style or slapstick violence to more realistic-looking violence or blood and gore.

values.label: Brutal Violence
values.definition: Visually explicit portrayals of violence, which may be characterized by extreme brutality, extreme bloodletting, and/or extreme tissue damage. May include images of torture, horror, or war.

values.label: Coarse Language
values.definition: Product contains profanity, threats, slurs, sexual references, or sexual innuendo.

values.label: Crude Content
values.definition: Material or humour that is unrefined or coarse and that may be seen as harsh, rude, or offensive.

values.label: Disturbing Content
values.definition: Indicates the expected natural reaction by an audience to any elements of a film, including the tone of a film, pertaining to distress or suffering. This includes the implication or threat of physical and/or psychological violence, even when violence is not depicted.

values.label: Explicit Sexual Content
values.definition: Sexual acts, shown in full, clear, unequivocal, and realistic detail, that may or may not be gratuitous to the film.

values.label: Frightening Scenes
values.definition: The film contains images that might shock or frighten a person. These scenes might be found in a thriller, suspense, or war genre.

values.label: Gory Scenes
values.definition: Graphic images of bloodletting and/or tissue damage. Includes horror or war representations. Degree, frequency, and intensity will also be a major factor in the classification decision.

values.label: Language May Offend
values.definition: Contains language that may be offensive to some groups, i.e. sacrilegious language such as Goddamn also used for PG films that contain explicative.

values.label: Mature Theme
values.definition: Contains images or storylines that may be disturbing or incomprehensible to minors. The film may contain portrayals of domestic violence, racism, religious matters, death, or controversial social issues.

values.label: Nudity
values.definition: Contains images of full frontal, partial, or rear nudity. Context will be determined by the situation, clarity, detail, repetition, and whether the nudity is in a non-sexual or sexual situation.

values.label: Not Recommended For Children
values.definition: The film may include scenes that reflect a more mature situation, such as drug use/abuse. "Children" would be persons age 13 and under.

values.label: Not Recommended For Young Children
values.definition: The film may be inappropriate for young children. An example might be the death of a family pet, a complicated family breakdown, or images considered frightening or disturbing for the very young. "Young Children" would be persons age 8 and under.

values.label: Substance Abuse
values.definition: Descriptive scenes depicting the use of illegal substances, the excessive use of tobacco, or the use of alcohol resulting in impairment.

values.label: Sexual Content
values.definition: Film may contain images and/or verbal references of sexual themes, sexual innuendo, fondling, implied sexual activity, and simulated sexual activity.

values.label: Sexual Violence
values.definition: The degradation of an individual in a sexual manner. May contain images of non-consensual acts with the intent to inflict harm, for example: simulated rape, and/or the use of threat to force compliance in sexual activity.

values.label: Violence
values.definition: May contain restrained portrayals of non-graphic violence, portrayals of violence with some bloodletting and/or tissue damage, and frequent more prolonged portrayals of violence resulting in bloodletting and tissue damage. The degree, frequency and intensity of the acts of violence will be factors in the classification decision.

values.label: Adult Humour
values.definition: Adult Humour

values.label: Adult Language
values.definition: Adult Language

values.label: Adult Situations
values.definition: Adult Situations

values.label: Brief Nudity
values.definition: Brief Nudity

values.label: Child Classic
values.definition: Child Classic

values.label: Drug Content
values.definition: Drug Content

values.label: Excellent for Children
values.definition: Excellent for Children

values.label: Gore
values.definition: Gore

values.label: Graphic Violence
values.definition: Graphic Violence

values.label: Mild Violence
values.definition: Mild Violence

values.label: Nudity
values.definition: Nudity

values.label: Not for Children
values.definition: Not for Children

values.label: Okay for Children
values.definition: Okay for Children

values.label: Profanity
values.definition: Profanity

values.label: Questionable for Children
values.definition: Questionable for Children

values.label: Substance Abuse (Alcohol, Drugs)
values.definition: Substance Abuse (Alcohol, Drugs)

values.label: Strong Sexual Content
values.definition: Strong Sexual Content

values.label: Sexual Situations
values.definition: Sexual Situations

values.label: Sexual Violence
values.definition: Sexual Violence

values.label: Violence
values.definition: Violence

values.label: Bio-based polymer
values.definition: The material is made from bio-based polymers whole or partially from renewable biological resources, like sugar cane, starch.

values.label: Crude Oil
values.definition: The material is made from crude oil.

values.label: Virgin/new raw material other
values.definition: The material is made from virgin, non-recycled raw materials, such as aluminium or wood.

values.label: Recycled
values.definition: The material is made from post consumer recycled content.

values.label: Additional Declared Net Content
values.definition: Used to identify an additional net content to provide an additional expression of the same net content.

values.label: Add Additional Language
values.definition: Used to identify the addition of one or more languages to the product’s primary language.

values.label: Marketing Declarations
values.definition: Used to identify a marketing declaration such as “Improved Scent” and “Lasts 2x longer”… which are designed to impact consumer decisions.

values.label: Minor Artwork Changes
values.definition: Used to identify an artwork change to the package artwork to promote or market the product.

values.label: Minor Formulation Change
values.definition: Used to identify a small change of formulation (example: a change to a type of oil that does not impact allergen claims…but may impact consumer decisions or online information)

values.label: Packaging with Minor Impact
values.definition: Used to identify a change to the dimensions (H W D) of a product that is less than 20%. Changing packaging dimensions less than 20% may still have an impact on consumer decision in certain product categories.

values.label: Primary Version
values.definition: Status on a CPV to notify recipient that a CPV is no longer active and that a previous version is now the active primary version.

values.label: Produced In different Locations
values.definition: Used to identify when a country of origin must be distinguished and declared, but a new GTIN is not required (apparel), CPV allows for that sharing. Likely to impact consumer decisions in many product categories.

values.label: Product Name and Description
values.definition: Used to identify a change in name or description of a product (example: from “Spicy” potato chips to “Bold and Spicy”). Such a change may impact consumer decisions or online information.

values.label: Reconfiguration of Consumer Pack
values.definition: Used to identify a change in the configuration of a package, for example from a “sports top” to a twist off cap. This could impact consumer decisions or online information.

values.label: Removial of Additional Declared Content UOM
values.definition: Used to identify the removal of an additional net content expression.

values.label: Remove Additional Language
values.definition: Used to identify the removal of one or more languages from the product’s primary language.

values.label: Time Critical Promotion
values.definition: Used to identify a seasonal/time critical artwork/marketing declaration.

values.label: Vintage
values.definition: Particularly used for high-volume/sell through wine who’s quality/price is not distinguishable by vintage but that contains a year on the bottle (as this year may impact a consumer decision).

values.label: Lot number
values.definition: Lot number

values.label: Serial number
values.definition: Serial number

values.label: Software version
values.definition: Software version

values.label: Unique device identifier - device identifier (UDI-DI)
values.definition: Unique device identifier - device identifier (UDI-DI)

values.label: Self Service
values.definition: The product should be placed in an area where the consumer can self serve themselves to their purchase needs. The product may have been portioned, cut or modified prior.

values.label: Service Counter
values.definition: The product is recommended to be placed at a location where an employee from the trading partner will need to portion, cut, or modify the product to the end consumer based upon consumer need

values.label: Not Required
values.definition: Protective equipment is not required.

values.label: Recommended
values.definition: It is advised that protective equipment should be worn.

values.label: Required
values.definition: Protective equipment must be worn

values.label: Added
values.definition: A new record has been added to the data base.

values.label: Changed
values.definition: An existing record has been updated.

values.label: Deleted
values.definition: An existing record has been deleted.

values.label: Not Found
values.definition: No record found.

values.label: 360 Degree Image
values.definition: Allows x-axis interactive rotation of product via website.

values.label: 3D rendered model
values.definition: 3D rendered models, are digital constructs which can be inserted into video files, or from which product still shots can be extracted. These are standalone files, rather than digital images.

values.label: Ambience/mood image
values.definition: Trade Item image representing the image the manufacturer is supplying to the consumer to invoke a connection to the item by setting a "mood" or feeling for the item and its use.

values.label: Application image
values.definition: Trade Item image representing the image the manufacturer is supplying to the consumer to depict how the product itself is used.

values.label: Assembly Instructions
values.definition: Link to a file the explains how to assemble (put together) the trade item.

values.label: Audio
values.definition: Link to a file containing an audio clip which is relevant to the product. Examples are commercials, or instructional/ how to use audio files.

values.label: Award certificate
values.definition: The award certificate is a written document created by the Award Committee that describes the terms and conditions of the Award. Example: http://www.cronierwines.com/awards-in-2016/

values.label: Barcode
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the barcode which is on the product or its packaging.

values.label: Certification
values.definition: Document which contains a special certification by a third party (e.g. International Food Standard [IFS], QS-Approval Mark for meat product, sausage, fruit, vegetables and potatoes or bio audits).

values.label: Certification seals/claims image
values.definition: Link to a file containing the certification seal or claim image (one or many). It is used to specifically identify the information related to a product’s certifications, claims or seals (regulatory, marketing, etc.) showing the logo of the certification body, that appears on any level of a products hierarchy (case, inner, each).

values.label: Chemical Assessment Summary
values.definition: Link to a file containing the chemical ingredient information sent to the supplier from a third party as a result of the assessment.

values.label: Chemical Safety Report
values.definition: Link to the file containing a report detailing the risks arising from the manufacture and/or use of a substance and to ensure that they are adequately controlled.

values.label: Child Nutrition Label
values.definition: Link to a file containing the Child Nutrition Label as formatted according to regulations and rules of an appropriate regulatory body for the target market.

values.label: Cleaning, disinfection and sterilisation instructions
values.definition: The cleaning, disinfection and/or sterilisation instructions that apply to the product. These may be in accordance with EN-ISO 17664.

values.label: Clinician medicine information
values.definition: A clinician focused product information document that is written by the pharmaceutical company responsible for the medicine. This document is intended to assist doctors, pharmacists and other health professionals in prescribing and dispensing medicines. In addition, this information can be used by health professionals in their consultations with patients, so that the patient can be better informed about their medicines.

values.label: Colour palette
values.definition: Link to a website, file, or image containing the product's colour palette to show the full overview of the different colours of the product. The overview is mainly used by suppliers to indicate the colours with their own reference numbers and names e.g. in cosmetics for make up, nail polish, lip stick etc.

values.label: Consumer Handling and Storage
values.definition: Link to a website, file, or image containing the manufacturer's recommendations for how the consumer or end user should store and handle the product.

values.label: Content/texture image
values.definition: Trade Item image representing the image the manufacturer is supplying to the consumer to depict the content or texture of an item. The image should be designed in such a way that the texture can be experienced by the consumer similar to stationary retail, e.g. creme, lipstick.

values.label: Crosssection View
values.definition: A picture of a trade item with a cut away vertical plane removed (e.g. Cross-section of a Tire revealing steel belts and tire tread detail).

values.label: Declaration of Conformity
values.definition:
A Declaration of Conformity is a document in which the manufacturer states that the product satisfies the essential requirements of the applicable legislation(s), e.g. for toys, medical devices or electrical equipment. By drawing up and signing the EU Declaration of Conformity, the manufacturer assumes responsibility for the compliance of the product. For more information please see
https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=CELEX:32019R1020&from=DE

values.label: Detail/technology image
values.definition: A Detail (Technology) image is a photo, line art or other graphic representation of a specific product feature or characteristic. It is used to highlight that specific detail of an item.

values.label: Diet Certificate
values.definition: Link to a website or file containing a diet certificate granted to the product

values.label: Instructions for disposal
values.definition: Link to a website, file or instruction movie how to dispose a product properly or how to clean up a broken product in case the product contains materials like mercury.

values.label: Document
values.definition: Link to a document or text file containing product information. Examples of this type could be an instruction manual, assembly guide, or warranty document.

values.label: Dop Sheet
values.definition: Link to a file containing the product's Declaration of Performance Sheet (DOP). This file can be either an image or a document.

values.label: Drug Fact Label
values.definition: The file link is to a drug fact panel of the trade item. A drug fact label usually contains such items as active ingredients, uses, warnings, purpose, directions, etc.

values.label: Durability index table details
values.definition: Link to a file or an image containing table of durability index parameters.

values.label: Ecological fact sheet
values.definition: Link to a file containing the details of a product with its environmental impact and performance. E.g. Beelong.ch Eco-Score Fact Sheet.

values.label: Energy Label
values.definition: Link to the energy label for a trade item.  On 19 May 2010, the EU adopted the Directive 2010/30/EU on energy labels. Energy labels help consumers choosing products which save energy and thus money. They also provide incentives for the industry to develop and invest in energy efficient product design. They are found on a selection of white goods and other products and are designed to help customers see how energy efficient a model is before they buy.

values.label: EPREL Product Information Sheet
values.definition: Link to the Product Information Sheet stored in the EPREL (European Product Registry for Energy Labelling). These sheets are in PDF and can be provided in multiple different languages.

values.label: Food contact conformity certificate
values.definition: The certificate of conformity for suitability for food contact is a document issued by the manufacturer or the person placing the product on the European market. It certifies that the product sold complies with the EC Regulation 1935/2004. Thus, it is proven to be safe to get in contact with food.

values.label: Hazardous Substances Data
values.definition: Link to a file where to locate the ‘out of network data’ additional data concerning the control of substances can be found.

values.label: IFU/eIFU (Instructions for use)
values.definition: Link to a file containing the (electronic) Instructions For Use (IFU or eIFU).

values.label: Instructions for use including cleaning disinfection sterilisation instructions
values.definition: Indicates that the instructions for cleaning/disinfecting/sterilisation are included in the IFU (Instructions For Use).

values.label: Ingredients label
values.definition: The Ingredients label image is a list of ingredients printed on the packaging. It may be separated by language in multiple areas on the product.

values.label: Internal View
values.definition: The picture of the inside of a trade item mainly used for non food products (e.g., The inside of a refrigerator or the inside of a suitcase.

values.label: Lighting fact label
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing information related to the light characteristics of the product. The lighting facts label makes it easy to compare bulb characteristics such as brightness, colour, life, and estimated operating cost for the year.

values.label: Logo
values.definition: Link to a file containing the Manufacturer or Brand Logo(s) associated with the product.

values.label: Marketing Information
values.definition: Link to a file with product information associated with selling a product or service.

values.label: Material Samples
values.definition: URL to website, images that the potential material, swatches, finishes the trade item might be available in.

values.label: Mobile Device Image
values.definition: Trade Item image that represents the image the manufacturer supplies to the consumer for mobile device applications. This would be a pack shot or image of the trade item that may be optimised for digital mobile display or added elements to help consumer recoginise the product. This should not be used as the Mobile Ready Hero Image. Some regulations require an actual image of the product and do not allow Mobile Ready Hero Images.

values.label: Mobile Ready Hero Image
values.definition: A Mobile Ready Hero Image (MRHI) is a representation of a real world product that may differ from a standard pack shot, but that maintains the majority of the physical pack’s key elements of design, shape and colour, and is therefore recognisable on a digital shelf. In addition the image should contain elements of The 4 Ws: Who is the brand, What it is, Which variety it is and how much. The Mobile Ready Hero Image (MRHI) is specified in the GS1 Mobile Ready Hero Image Guideline https://www.gs1.org/standards/Mobile-Ready-Hero-Image

values.label: Montage image
values.definition: A Montage is the physical over layering of distinct images to create a final digital image. This process allows for a composite to be created with the future possibility of reconstruction without having to return to studio for correction, should an element be added or removed.

values.label: Nutrition Fact Label
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing the nutritional information.

values.label: Nutrition Fact Label with Ingredients
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing the nutritional information with the inclusion of the ingredient statement.

values.label: Optimised hero image
values.definition: An Optimised Hero Image type is to support retail, consumers, distributors and foodservice operators in completing their online sites. These images will assist consumers to identify specific information about the products they are purchasing. The image is a representation of a real world product, built specifically for use on larger screens that may differ from a standard pack shot, but that maintains the majority of the physical pack’s key elements of design, shape and colour, and is therefore recognisable on a digital shelf.

values.label: Organic Certificate
values.definition: Link to a website or file containing an organic certificate granted to the product.

values.label: Other External Information
values.definition: Link to a file containing product information of an unspecified type.

values.label: Out of Package Image
values.definition: Link to an image of an item out of its packaging and, if necessary, assembled ready for use by the end user. This type of file is subject the current version of the GDSN Product Image Specification Standard.

values.label: Packaging Artwork
values.definition: Design files for packaging artwork for example Adobe source files.

values.label: Patient information leaflet
values.definition: A leaflet or brochure containing important information to patients/consumers about the product to facilitate discussion and assist with the decision-making process. Example: A leaflet on a medical device like a hip joint. Or a consumer/patient-focused leaflet that contains information on the safe and effective use of a medicines. Often known in some markets as Consumer Medicines Information sheet (CMI), Product Information Leaflet (PiL/ePIL).

values.label: Petfood Feeding Instructions
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing the feeding instructions for the petfood product.

values.label: Pharmaceutical Drugs/Medical Devices
values.definition: The Pharmaceutical Drugs/Medical Devices images refers to products (medical devices or pharmaceutical drugs and components) used in the diagnosis, treatment or prevention of disease that achieves its primary intended purpose through pharmacological, immunological or metabolic means within or on the body. Includes medical equipment and supplies, all drugs, biologicals or therapeutic nutritionals for human applications.

values.label: Planogram
values.definition: Link to a file illustrating how and where retail products should be displayed.

values.label: Preparation Instructions
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing the preparation instructions.

values.label: Product Formulation Statement
values.definition: Link to a file containing the Product Formulation Statement, in lieu of a Child Nutrition Label, as formatted according to regulations and rules of an appropriate regulatory body for the target market.

values.label: Product Image
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product.

values.label: Product image formed
values.definition: An image of a product that has the supporting shape/form (for example a model, mannequin, hanger) removed to give the product a 3-D look.

values.label: Product image with supporting elements
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product on a white or transparent background, with additional elements that are not part of the product being sold, intended to enhance its presentation (e.g., a glass of wine and a stem of grapes alongside a bottle of wine).

values.label: Product Label Image
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label.

values.label: Product Website
values.definition: Link to a website containing product specific information. Examples of this could be a link to a website dedicated to the product or a link to the area within the manufacturer or brand owner website that contains the product information

values.label: Link to QR Code
values.definition: Link to a QR code URL/URI.

values.label: Quality Control Plan
values.definition: Document which detailed information about the quantity of laboratory/analytical tests and the evaluated parameters.

values.label: Recipe Website
values.definition: Link to a website containing recipes associated with the product

values.label: Recyclability assessment certificate
values.definition: Link to a file containing the certificate for recyclability granted to the packaging of the item.

values.label: Regulated product content website
values.definition: Link for a regulatory or industry governed product content website containing product specific information.

values.label: Regulatory Inspection Audit
values.definition: Inspection report of the inspections. For example foodstuffs, pharmaceuticals and other types of products that are regulated.

values.label: Repairability index table details
values.definition: Link to a file or an image containing the table of repairability index parameters.

values.label: Risk Analysis Document
values.definition: Document which describes how the supplier assured the quality control of the end products or during the production process. The process can be a supplier internal control system, a simple kind of risk analysis or systematic preventive approach according Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP).

values.label: Safety Data Sheet
values.definition: Link to a file containing the product's Safety Data Sheet (SDS). This file can be either an image or a document

values.label: Safety Summary Sheet
values.definition: A link to a summary sheet document that is available to workers to understand how to deal with chemicals in an emergency situation.

values.label: Sample Shipping Order
values.definition: Document is a sample shipping order. A sample shipping order isn´t needed for every item (GTIN), but a shipping order can differ from GTIN to GTIN. E.g. in case an item is an organic product the sample shipping order needs to contain the organic product origin number according article 31 of the implementing regulations EG Nr. 889/2008. For non-organic items this information isn´t needed.

values.label: Sidekick image
values.definition: Retail, consumers, distributors and foodservice operators complete their online transactions using their smart devices. These images may be used to inform a customer of benefits or nutritional claims of a product. This is a supplementary image or graphic, generally used to support the Hero image.

values.label: Size Comparison
values.definition: An image that makes clear the actual size of the product, e.g., via a schematic depiction of a person or well-known object (e.g., one-euro coin) in the background.

values.label: Social media image
values.definition: Trade Item image representing the image the manufacturer is supplying to the consumer to depict the social media associated to the item. This image is being shared on the social media outlet.

values.label: Summary of Product Characteristics
values.definition: Specific document required before any medicinal product or biocidal product is authorized for marketing.  Example European Commission

values.label: Supplement facts label
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product label containing information related to the supplement or nutrient product. The supplement facts label provides about what active/nutritional ingredients are used in the formula along with dosage recommendations for dietary supplements.

values.label: Sustainability image
values.definition: Link to a file containing an image which emphasizes the features or characteristics of the product related to recyclability, reusability, product and packaging components, environmental impact etc.

values.label: Technical data sheet
values.definition: The product specification sheet, created by the manufacturer, summarises the technical characteristics and other properties of the product, relating to technological and commercial purposes. Example: https://dl.gedal.fr/docsgedal/FP/3255290252425.pdf

values.label: Technical Drawing
values.definition:
A precise and detailed technical drawing of an object, as employed in industries such as engineering, construction, architecture etc. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_drawing
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_drawing

values.label: Testing Methodology Results
values.definition: Document which contains microbiological and physico-chemical findings of the product which are observed during product testing.

values.label: Trade Item Description
values.definition: Identifies the reference to an external description of a Trade Item. The link (e.g. URL) to the external description. will be in the appropriate attribute

values.label: Trade Item Image With Dimensions
values.definition: Link to a website, file, or image containing the product's image with its dimensions. This especially important for built-in products as ovens and fridges. Ex : http://www.docstoc.com/docs/125126778/GSS-GEW-Food-Savers-Food-Storage-Containers.

values.label: Training instructions
values.definition: Link to a file containing the training instructions to support the safe and effective use of the product.

values.label: Video file
values.definition: Link to a product-related video file. Examples are commercials, trailers, or instructional / how to use video files.

values.label: Video website
values.definition: Link to a product-related video that can be played online. Such video links are usually hosted on special platforms, such as YouTube, Vimeo and TikTok.

values.label: Visual verification image
values.definition: Link to a file containing a visual representation of the product for the purpose of visual verification. Usage may be to examine the trade item master data against the product image. Note these images might not necessarily comply with image standards and may be restricted for a visual verification usage.

values.label: Warranty Information
values.definition: Link to a file with information associated with any guarantee given by a company stating that a product is reliable and free from known defects and that the seller will, without charge, repair or replace defective parts within a given time limit and under certain conditions.

values.label: Website
values.definition: Link to a website containing product or manufacturer information.

values.label: Zoom View
values.definition: A picture of a portion of a trade item (e.g., the wheels of a suitcase or the ingredients list of a food trade item).

values.label: Accessory/Add-on included
values.definition: Accessory/Add-on which can be used with the Trade Item to aid/enhance in its functionality or operation.

values.label: Accessory/Add-on sold separately
values.definition: Accessory/Add-on which is sold separately, that can be used with the Trade Item to aid/enhance in its functionality or operation.

values.label: Dependent Proprietary
values.definition: Dependent trade items are Trade Items which may be required or which may be used in conjunction with the current trade item to make the current trade item functional.

values.label: Equivalent
values.definition: A product which can be substituted for the trade item based on supplier- defined functional equivalence to the trade item.

values.label: Item Variant Master
values.definition: Another trade item of which this trade item is a variant. Used when the trade item is a variant of a previously specified trade item for example a new flavour of an existing soft drink. This reference may be used when the trade item has identical package type, physical dimensions and brand name as the itemVariantMaster trade item. This attribute only creates a logical link to a similar product. It is not used to negate the need for sending all item information about this product.

values.label: Preferred
values.definition: A GTIN identification assigned by the manufacturer for the purpose of grouping multiple versions of the same title (e.g. limited edition, etc.).

values.label: Primary Alternative
values.definition: A Trade Item that is similar to the current Trade Item but is not exact match. Same form fit function, e.g. same product different colour, different package size, better quality.

values.label: Replaced
values.definition: Indicates the trade item identification of an item that is being permanently replaced by this trade item.

values.label: Replaced By
values.definition: The trade item which permanently replaces the current trade item. This Trade Item is sent in the record for the original item that is being replaced.

values.label: Substituted
values.definition: The original trade item that is temporarily being replaced. This attribute is used with the replacement trade item.

values.label: Substituted By
values.definition: The trade item that is temporarily replacing the original GTIN. This attribute is used on the original trade item.

values.label: Canceled
values.definition: The catalogue item that was never manufactured has been removed from the Global Registry.

values.label: Discontinued
values.definition: The catalogue item that has been in the supply chain has been removed from the supply chain.

values.label: In Progress
values.definition: The Catalogue Item is in the process of being processed at the Global Registry.

values.label: Registered
values.definition: The Catalogue Item has been registered at the Global Registry.

values.label: Carcinogenic mutagenic reprotoxic (CMR) substance
values.definition: Carcinogenic mutagenic reprotoxic (CMR) substance

values.label: Endocrine substance
values.definition: Endocrine substance

values.label: Human product
values.definition: Human product

values.label: Medicinal product
values.definition: Medicinal product

values.label: Country
values.definition: A nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory.

values.label: Municipality
values.definition: A city, town, or other district possessing corporate existence and usually its own local government.

values.label: Province or state
values.definition: One of the constituent units of a nation having a federal government.

values.label: Union
values.definition: A group of states or nations united into one political body.

values.label: Aerosol_Reverse Epsilon
values.definition: Products complying with all the requirements of the Aerosol Directive are marked with the "reverse epsilon" symbol

values.label: Agriculture_Protection Regulation
values.definition: Products complying with EU Council Directive 91/414/EEC. This directive concerning the placing of plant protection products on the market lays down rules and procedures for approval of the active substances at EU-level and for the authorisation at Member State level of plant protection products (PPPs) containing these substances. This Directive states that substances cannot be used in plant protection products unless they are included in a positive EU list. Once a substance is included in the positive list Member States may authorise the use of products containing them.

values.label: Alcohol beverages information regulation
values.definition: Regulation providing the basis for the assurance of a high level of consumer protection in relation to alcohol beverages information, taking into account the differences in the perception of consumers and their information needs whilst ensuring the smooth functioning of the market. General principles, requirements and responsibilities governing alcohol beverages information, and in particular alcohol labelling rules are established (e.g. EU regulation 2021/2117).

values.label: Animal Confinement Regulation
values.definition: The product has an animal confinement regulation designation. For example in the US, California Proposition 12 regulation requires veal calves, breeding pigs, and egg-laying hens to be housed in systems that comply with specific standards for freedom of movement, cage-free design, and specified minimum floor space.

values.label: Animal ID Health Mark
values.definition: Food business operators, in accordance with Regulation (EC) No 853/2004, should ensure that all products of animal origin that they place on the market, bear either a health mark or an identification mark.

values.label: Battery Directive
values.definition: Directive describing the legal requirements on batteries intended to made available on the market provided that such products are labelled, marked or accompanied with commercial documents. Essentially safety and environmental aspects are defined (e.g. obligation of the seller to take batteries back, proscription to throw batteries into the household garbage) for different type of batteries (e.g. batteries used by the end consumer, batteries used in cars). In Germany the law on batteries (BattG) details these rules.

values.label: Biocide Regulation
values.definition: Regulation (e.g., EU Reg 528/2012) harmonising the rules on making available on the market and using biocidal products whilst ensuring a high level of protection of both human and animal health and the environment. It should not be used for trade items treated with biocidal products ('treated articles').

values.label: BPA Regulation
values.definition: Indicates the product has a regulatory requirement to show to the consumer that it may or may not contain Bisphenol A (BPA).

values.label: Buy American Act
values.definition: The Buy American Act of 1933 requires United States federal government agencies to prefer domestic end products in their purchases. U.S. federal law establishes if a product is considered domestic for these purposes, as well as exceptions under certain circumstances.

values.label: Buy American Provision USDA
values.definition: The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) administers a Buy American provision requiring school food authorities to purchase, to the maximum extent practicable, domestic commodities or products. Program regulations establish if a commodity or product is considered domestic for these purposes, as well as exceptions under certain circumstances.

values.label: CE
values.definition: The CE marking is the manufacturer's, distributor's or EU authorised representative's declaration that the product meets EU standards for health, safety, protection of consumers and environmental protection in accordance with the regulation. The CE mark indicates that the product may be sold freely in any part of the European Economic Area, regardless of its country of origin. The mark consists of the CE logo and, if applicable, the four-digit identification number of the notified body involved in the conformity assessment procedure.

values.label: Competition Act
values.definition: Competition act encompasses several pivotal environmental-related additions designed to hold companies accountable for their environmental claims. These provisions aim to mitigate the pervasive issue of greenwashing, ensuring businesses can't make superficial or misleading claims about their environmental efforts. For example the Canadian Competition Act.

values.label: Compliant With Fair Labor Standards Act
values.definition: The FLSA established a national minimum wage guaranteed 'time-and-a-half' for overtime in certain jobs, and prohibited most employment of minors in "oppressive child labor," a term that is defined in the statute. It applies to employees engaged in interstate commerce or employed by an enterprise engaged in commerce or in the production of goods for commerce, unless the employer can claim an exemption from coverage.

values.label: Compliant With Flammability Act
values.definition: Compliant With Flammability Act

values.label: Compliant With Fur Product Labeling Act
values.definition: Requires the country of origin of imported furs to be disclosed on all labels and in all advertising

values.label: Compliant With State Environment Requirements
values.definition: NOT AVAILABLE

values.label: Compliant With Textile Fiber Product Identification
values.definition: A US regulation regarding the advertising and labelling of textile fibre products.

values.label: Compliant With Wool Products Labeling Act
values.definition: A US regulation that requires anyone who manufacturers or sells products containing wool to accurately label each item with the fibre content and origin

values.label: Consumer product safety
values.definition: Regulation ensuring that products placed on the market are safe for consumer use, enhancing market surveillance and traceability, and introducing clear obligations for economic operators to prevent and manage product risks. E.g., EU Regulation 2023/988, or regulations from the Consumer Product Safety Commission in the US.

values.label: Contains Composite Wood
values.definition: Describes that the trade item or packaging contains composite wood that falls under regulatory menas due to chemicals used in process to create the wood, such as Formaldehyde  has both cancer and noncancer-causing effects on human health. For example:  California Air Resources Board is a department of the California Environmental Protection Agency. CARB’s mission, US EPA. https://www.epa.gov/formaldehyde .

values.label: Cosmetic_Information Regulation
values.definition: Regulation (EU Reg 1223/2009) establishing rules to be complied with any cosmetic product made available on the market, a high level of protection of human health and a high degree of protection of the environment. These rules include the necessity to indicate allergens and the displaying of the ingredients used in the product.

values.label: Declaration of performance (DOP) required
values.definition: A Declaration Of Performance (DOP) is legally required. See target market regulations for applicability.

values.label: Deforestation regulation
values.definition: Regulation minimising the contribution to deforestation and forest degradation worldwide, and thereby contributing to a reduction in global deforestation; reducing the contribution to greenhouse gas emissions and global biodiversity loss (e.g., EU regulation 2023/1115).

values.label: Detergents_Safety Regulation
values.definition: Regulation  establishing rules designed to achieve the free movement of detergents and surfactants for detergents in the market while, at the same time, ensuring a high degree of protection of the environment and human health. For example (EU Reg 648/2004)

values.label: Efficiency of Lamps Luminaries
values.definition: A directive defining the energy labeling of electrical lamps and luminaires (e.g. EU Reg 874/2012). This directive deals with environmental aspects as the electricity used by electrical lamps accounts for a significant share of total electricity demand.

values.label: EMC Directive
values.definition: The main objective of the Directive 2004/108/EC of the European Council, of 15 December 2004, is to regulate the compatibility of equipment regarding EMC (Electromagnetic Compatibility).

values.label: Enclosed Attached Information
values.definition: Indicates the product contains enclosed or attached information available for regulatory compliance where applicable.

values.label: Energy Guide Label Required
values.definition: A code that indicates that a trade item is in compliance with energy efficiency guide and is labelled as such.

values.label: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)
values.definition: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) refers to any regulatory framework that requires producers to take responsibility for the entire lifecycle of their products, including packaging and relevant product components, covering collection, take-back, recycling, and final disposal (e.g., California SB 54, Colorado HB22-1355, Maine LD 1541).

values.label: EU Regulation Label Required
values.definition:
Regulation (EC) No 178/2002 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 28 January 2002 laying down the general principles and requirements of food law, establishing the European Food Safety Authority and laying down procedures in matters of food safety. 
For the purposes of this Regulation, "food" (or "foodstuff") means any substance or product, whether processed, partially processed or unprocessed, intended to be, or reasonably expected to be ingested by humans. "Food" includes: drink, chewing gum and any substance, including water, intentionally incorporated into the food during its manufacture, preparation or treatment. It includes water after the point of compliance.

values.label: Restricted explosive precursors
values.definition: The product is concerned with the marketing and use of explosives precursors and must be registered by the economic operator. Explosives precursors are chemical substances that can be used for legitimate purposes, but that can also be misused to manufacture homemade explosives. For example restricted explosive precursors listed in Annex I of the Regulation (EU) No 2019/1148.

values.label: Reportable explosive precursors
values.definition: The product is concerned with the marketing and use of explosives precursors and must be reported by the economic operator. Explosives precursors are chemical substances that can be used for legitimate purposes, but that can also be misused to manufacture homemade explosives. For example reportable explosive precursors listed in Annex II of the Regulation (EU) No 2019/1148.

values.label: E-mark
values.definition: The Estimated Sign (℮) (also referred to as "e-mark") is a mark that sometimes can be found on pre-packed goods in Europe. The e-mark indicates that the packaging is filled according to the European Directive 76/211/EEC.

values.label: Feed_Safety Regulation
values.definition: Regulation (EU Reg 767/2009) to harmonise the conditions for the placing on the market and the use of feed, in order to ensure a high level of feed safety and thus a high level of protection of public health, as well as to provide adequate information for users and consumers.

values.label: Fish and seafood traceability
values.definition: Regulation ensuring full traceability of fish and seafood products throughout the entire value chain — from fisherman or farmer to retail — thereby supporting regulatory compliance, food safety, and sustainable fisheries management. E.g., EU Regulations 1224/2009 and 2023/2842.

values.label: Food For Special Purposes
values.definition: Regulation providing the basis for the assurance of a high level of consumer protection in relation to specialized food like food for infants and young children, food for special medical purposes, and total diet replacement for weight control (e.g. EU Reg 609/2013).

values.label: Food_Information Regulation
values.definition: Regulation providing the basis for the assurance of a high level of consumer protection in relation to food information. General principles, requirements and responsibilities governing food information, and in particular food labelling rules are established (e.g., EU regulation 1169/2011). These rules include the necessity to indicate allergens, the responsible food business operator, the name of the food, the displaying of the ingredients and additives used.

values.label: Food Labelling Under 2 Years of Age
values.definition: Foods, other than infant formula, represented or purported to be specifically for infants and children less than 2 years of age shall bear nutrition labelling.

values.label: Food Labelling Under 4 Years of Age
values.definition: Foods, other than infant formula, represented or purported to be specifically for infants and children less than 4 years of age shall bear nutrition labelling.

values.label: Food_Supplement Directive
values.definition: Food supplements (EU directive 2002/46/EC) marketed as foodstuffs and presented as such. These products shall be delivered to the ultimate consumer only in a pre-packaged form. Consumer health and safety aspects are in focus as well as to provide adequate information on how to use the product properly.

values.label: Free Pharmaceutical Products Directive
values.definition: Directive describing the legal requirements on pharmaceutical products which are commercially available and intended to made available on the market provided that such products are labelled, marked or accompanied with commercial documents. General Consumer safety aspects are in focus like the dosage form linked with an application instruction (e.g. Do not use with alcohol). In Germany the law on medical products (AMG) details these rules.

values.label: French Spare Parts Regulation
values.definition: Decree No. 2014-1482 of 9 December 2014 on the information and supply obligations concerning spare parts indispensable for the use of a good

values.label: Hazards classification, labelling and packaging regulation
values.definition: Regulation providing the basis to ensure that workers and consumers are clearly informed of the hazards associated with chemicals by means of a system of classification and labelling. The aim is to ensure that the same hazards are described and labelled in the same way in all concerned countries (e.g. Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 December 2008 on Classification, Labelling and Packaging (CLP) of substances and mixtures).

values.label: Herbicide Regulation
values.definition: The item is a substance used to control unwanted plants that are subject to regulation.

values.label: Infant formula Labelling
values.definition: Infant formula except foods, shall be labelled in compliance with regulations.

values.label: Intended to Come Into Contact with Food
values.definition: Requires that food contact materials a re safe; Must not transfer their components into food in quantities that could endanger human health, change food composition in an unacceptable way or deteriorate its taste and odour. Are manufactured according to good manufacturing practice.

values.label: LVD Directive
values.definition: The Low Voltage Directive (LVD) 2006/95/EC provides common broad objectives for safety regulations, so that electrical equipment approved by any EU member country will be acceptable for use in all other EU countries. The Low Voltage Directive does not supply any specific technical standards that must be met, instead relying on IEC technical standards to guide designers to produce safe products. Products that conform to the general principles of the Low Voltage Directive and the relevant particular safety standards are marked with the CE marking to indicate compliance and acceptance throughout the EU. Conformance is asserted by the manufacturer based on its conformity assessment.

values.label: Market Authorisation
values.definition: The trade item has been authorised to be sold by a regulatory agency to be distributed in a market.

values.label: Medical_Device Safety
values.definition: A directive establishing common rules on the safety, health protection and performance characteristics of medical devices in order to provide the safety and health protection of patients, users and, where appropriate, other persons, with regard to the use of medical devices ((e.g. Medical Device Regulation (EU) 2017/745) and in-vitro diagnostic devices (e.g. In vitro Diagnostic Device Regulation (EU) 2017/746)).

values.label: Minimum Durability
values.definition: Indicates the product has a regulatory requirement to show to the consumer the best to use before period so they obtain the full functionality of the product.

values.label: Nano Materials Presence
values.definition: Indicates the presence of nano materials by the levels acceptable by the appropriate regulation. Note: in Europe, use code NANOPARTICLE in attribute claimElementCode instead.

values.label: Not Applicable
values.definition: Not Applicable.

values.label: Packaging Safety Directive
values.definition: The product represented in its packaging and/or marketing as appropriate for use by persons as defined by regulatory agency?  Includes packaging, display, photography, licensed characters, promotion or advertising (in-store or ad) as appropriate for use by persons. An example is the Consumer Product Safety Commission regulation: https://www.cpsc.gov/Regulations-Laws--Standards/Statutes/Poison-Prevention-Packaging-Act/Child-Resistant-and-Senior-Friendly-Packages-packaging-guide/.

values.label: Period Safe To Use After Opening
values.definition: Indicates the product has a regulatory requirement to show to the consumer that product is denoted to have a period of time after opening before it becomes harmful to the consumer.

values.label: Pesticide Regulation
values.definition: The item is a substance used to control unwanted pests that are subject to regulation.

values.label: Pharmaceutical_Product Directive
values.definition: In contrast to the free pharmaceutical directive this directive describing the legal requirements on pharmaceutical products available only in pharmacies. These products have stronger regulations and restrictions to consumer safety aspects. For example the dosage recommendation needs to be explained in detail by the sales staff as well as possible interaction with other pharmaceutical products.

values.label: Plastic directive
values.definition: Directive on the reduction of the impact of certain plastic products on the environment (e.g., directive (EU) 2019/904).

values.label: Product Labelling Regulation
values.definition: A code indicating the trade item is compliant with the food labelling regulation.

values.label: Product of Daily Use Directive
values.definition: Directive describing the legal requirements on the products of daily use focusing on consumer safety (e.g. do not use with …, not used by children). An example is the German directive BedGgstV.

values.label: Proposition 65 (Prop 65) [US California]
values.definition: Containing specific toxicants for a product which contains carcinogens and/or reproductive toxicants established in California’s Proposition 65 (Prop 65), The Safe Drinking Water and Toxic Enforcement Act, enacted in 1986.  This Act requires the state to publish a list of chemicals known to cause cancer or reproductive harm. Prop 65 applies to suppliers who sell products in the state if their products exceed safe harbour levels established in Prop 65. Safe harbour levels establish thresholds for no significant risk levels (NSRLs) for carcinogens and maximum allowable dose levels (MADLs) for chemicals that cause reproductive toxicity.

values.label: Public procurement requirements
values.definition: Requirements established by public procurement agencies, such as the Swedish National Agency for Public Procurement (NAPP), that incorporate environmental and social considerations.

values.label: Regulated by Agency
values.definition: The trade item is regulated by the agency stated in the regulatoryAgency attribute.

values.label: Returning of Electronic Product Directive
values.definition: Directive of the returning of electronic products ensuring a high degree of protection of the environment. This directive defines returning quotes of returning electronical products needs to be fulfilled by the industry and by retailers (e.g. ElektroG in Germany).

values.label: ROHS Directive
values.definition: Is not a quality mark but a European directive 2002/95/EC (stands for Restriction of Hazardous Substances). This directive restricts (with exceptions) the use of six hazardous materials like lead, cadmium and mercury in the manufacture of various types of electronic and electrical equipment.

values.label: Safety data sheet required
values.definition: A Safety Data Sheet (SDS) is legally required. See target market regulations for applicability.

values.label: Scattered pollution regulation
values.definition: Decree No. 2011-1650 of 25 November 2011 on the procedures for declaring and paying back the non-point pollution charge and for keeping the registers referred to in Articles L. 254-3-1 and L. 254-6 of the Rural and Maritime Fisheries Code.

values.label: Security of Electronic Products Directive
values.definition: Directive on the safety of electronic products covering consumer health as well as environmental aspects (e.g. German law on product safety ProdSG).

values.label: Small Parts Regulation
values.definition: A small part is any object that fits completely into a specified size by regulation that approximates the size of the fully expanded throat of a child of age specified by regulation. A small part can be a whole toy or article, a Separate part of a toy, game, or other article or a piece of a toy or article that breaks off during testing that simulates use or abuse by children. Example in US See 16 C.F.R. 1501.4.

values.label: Stuffed article labelling
values.definition: A code indicating the product labelling is regulated related to the fill material contained within the product, e.g., US and Canada law label.

values.label: Textile labelling regulation
values.definition: Regulation (EU Reg 1007/2011). This Regulation lays down rules concerning the use of textile fibre names and related labelling and marking of fibre composition of textile products, rules concerning the labelling or marking of textile products containing non-textile parts of animal origin and rules concerning the determination of the fibre composition of textile products by quantitative analysis of binary and ternary textile fibre mixtures, in order to provide accurate information to consumers.

values.label: Tobacco Directive
values.definition: The directive or regulation aims to improve the functioning of tobacco products within a market while ensuring a high level of public health protection. Example: European Directive 2014/40/EU on the manufacture, presentation and sale of cigarettes, roll-your-own tobacco, pipe tobacco, cigars, cigarillos, smokeless tobacco products, electronic cigarettes and plant-smoked products.

values.label: Toy safety directive
values.definition: Directive, which applies to products designed or intended, whether or not exclusively, for use in play by children under 14 years of age. Health and safety aspects of the child are in focus Amongst others security aspects of toys are defined (e.g. Warning: small components may be swallowed) as well as substances, which are not allowed to use in toys (e.g. softening agents).

values.label: Traceability Regulation
values.definition: Indicates that a trade item  is subject to government rules and regulations regarding traceability.

values.label: Trade item considered unpacked
values.definition: The trade item is considered as unpacked by regulation, even if physical packaging may exist. (E.g. European Regulation on fresh fruit & vegetables  EU 1169, EU 543, EU 852)

values.label: Trade Item Tested Directive
values.definition: The product has conformed to testing requirements to meet regulation needs. An example is the Consumer Product Safety Commission https://www.cpsc.gov/Regulations-Laws--Standards/Statutes/The-Consumer-Product-Safety-Improvement-Act/.

values.label: Biocide regulation treated article
values.definition: Regulation (e.g., EU Reg 528/2012) harmonising the rules on making available on the market and trade items treated with biocidal products ('treated articles'), whilst ensuring a high level of protection of both human and animal health and the environment. It should not be used for biocidal products.

values.label: Treated with Herbicide Regulation
values.definition: Trade item has been treated with herbicide(s) that are subject to regulation.

values.label: Treated with Pesticide Regulation.
values.definition: Trade item has been treated with pesticide(s) that are subject to regulation.

values.label: UK Conformity Assessed
values.definition: The UKCA (UK Conformity Assessed) marking is the UK product marking required for goods being placed on the market in Great Britain (England, Wales and Scotland) fully replacing the European CE marking from 1 January 2023. The UK CA marking supports fair competition by holding all companies accountable to the same rules. Reference: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/uk-conformity-assessment and https://www.gov.uk/guidance/using-the-ukca-marking.

values.label: Underwater Lighting
values.definition: The European standard EN 60598-2-18 is recognized by most countries as the safety standard for underwater lighting.

values.label: Unspecified
values.definition: Unspecified.

values.label: Uva
values.definition: EU 647 Cosmetic industry worked closely with the European Commission, and COLIPA, currently called COSMETICS EUROPE proposed a UVA labelling symbol. This indicates that the level of UVA protection provided by a product is at least 1/3 ratio of its SPF.  Manufacturers will show that their products meet the SPF/UVAPF ratio by displaying the letters “UVA” inside a circle whose diameter should not exceed the height of the SPF number.

values.label: Vehicle License Plate Registration
values.definition: Provides proof of the registered motorized vehicle plate number.

values.label: Vehicle Lighting Compliant
values.definition: Vehicle lighting meets regulatory compliance in road and off road safety. Example in the US is SAE-DOT

values.label: Volatile Organic Compound Compliant
values.definition: Organic chemicals that have a high vapor pressure at ordinary, room-temperature conditions. Their high vapor pressure results from a low boiling point, which causes large numbers of molecules to evaporate or sublimate from the liquid or solid form of the compound and enter the surrounding air

values.label: Warranty requirements
values.definition: Requirements which specify the product's warranty type (i.e., implied, express, etc.) and any terms and conditions applicable. Please refer to local regulations.

values.label: Above Regulated Levels
values.definition: Above Regulated Levels

values.label: Below Regulated Levels
values.definition: Below Regulated Levels

values.label: Exempt
values.definition: Exempt

values.label: Due diligence statement
values.definition: A document or dataset that states the reasonable steps and precautions taken by a person or organisation in order to avoid committing an offence or breaking a law.

values.label: Other
values.definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.

values.label: Earphone
values.definition: A source of sound output that controls the unit by means of an in-line remote control.

values.label: Not Applicable
values.definition: A statement that an affirmative or negative response is not required for the attribute.

values.label: Other
values.definition: Other than the standard values for the list.

values.label: Standard Single Device
values.definition: A remote control that operates a single device, usually the one it came with.

values.label: Universal Remote
values.definition: A remote control that can be programmed to operate various brands of one or more types of consumer electronics devices.

values.label: Animal Rennet
values.definition: Rennet derived from animals.

values.label: Microbial Rennet
values.definition: Rennet derived from mold able to produce proteolytic enzymes.

values.label: No Rennet
values.definition: No rennet

values.label: Vegetable Rennet
values.definition: Rennet derived from vegetable.

values.label: Other
values.definition: The value needed is not listed or is not defined within this list’s individual code values and definitions. Please send a work request into GS1 or your solution provider requesting the code you are searching for.

values.label: Reprocessing product
values.definition: An indication that education for reprocessing of the product is required. For example: In healthcare, adequate reprocessing of reusable medical devices is critically important in protecting patient safety. Reprocessing is intended to remove blood, tissue, and other biological debris to inactivate infectious microbes so that devices are safe for the next patient.

values.label: Safe use
values.definition: An indication that education or training is required to use the product safely.

values.label: Camera
values.definition: The maximum resolution of the device's camera.

values.label: Image
values.definition: The maximum image resolution for the device.

values.label: Output
values.definition: The maximum resolution of the device's output.

values.label: Accepted
values.definition: Designates a positive response from the recipient.

values.label: Modified
values.definition: Designates a positive response from the recipient with modification.

values.label: No Action
values.definition: This line item is not affected by the actual message.

values.label: Rejected
values.definition: Designates a negative response from the recipient.

values.label: ODETTE
values.definition: Organization for Data Exchange through Tele-Transmission in Europe (European automotive industry project).

values.label: GS1 Switzerland
values.definition: Organisation responsible for the GS1 system in Switzerland.

values.label: US, U.S. Census Bureau
values.definition: The Bureau of the Census of the U.S. Dept. of Commerce.

values.label: GS1 US
values.definition: Organisation responsible for GS1 System in the USA.

values.label: US, ANSI ASC X12
values.definition: American National Standards Institute ASC X12

values.label: DE, German Bankers Association
values.definition: German Bankers' Association.

values.label: GS1 UK
values.definition: Organisation responsible for GS1 System in the UK.

values.label: S.W.I.F.T.
values.definition: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunications s.c.

values.label: DE, DIN (Deutsches Institut fuer Normung)
values.definition: German standardization institute.

values.label: US, Standard Carrier Alpha Code (Motor)
values.definition: Organisation maintaining the SCAC lists and transportation operating in North America.

values.label: CEC
values.definition: Commission of the European Communities

values.label: GS1 Netherlands
values.definition: Organisation responsible for GS1 System in the Netherlands.

values.label: GS1 Denmark
values.definition: Organisation responsible for GS1 System in Denmark.

values.label: GS1 Germany
values.definition: Organisation responsible for GS1 System in Germany.

values.label: Ediel Nordic forum
values.definition: A code to identify Ediel Nordic forum, which is an organization standardizing the use of EDI between the participants in the Nordic power market.

values.label: EDITEUR
values.definition: Code identifying the pan European user group for the book industry as an organisation responsible for code values in the book industry.

values.label: GS1 Belgium & Luxembourg
values.definition: Organisation responsible for GS1 System in Belgium & Luxembourg.

values.label: SE, TCO
values.definition: The Swedish Confederation of Professional Employees.

values.label: GS1 Austria
values.definition: Organisation responsible for the GS1 System in Austria.

values.label: GS1 Spain
values.definition: Organisation responsible for the GS1 System in Spain.

values.label: IATA
values.definition: International Air Transport Association

values.label: GS1 Finland
values.definition: Organisation responsible for the GS1 system in Finland.

values.label: GS1 Brazil
values.definition: Organisation responsible for the GS1 system in Brazil.

values.label: GS1 Ireland
values.definition: Organisation responsible for the GS1 system in Ireland.

values.label: GS1 Russia
values.definition: Organisation responsible for the GS1 system in Russia.

values.label: GS1 Poland
values.definition: Organisation responsible for the GS1 system in Poland.

values.label: GS1 Estonia
values.definition: Organisation responsible for the GS1 system in Estonia

values.label: PANTONE
values.definition: Color code controlling organisation

values.label: ISO
values.definition: International Organization for Standardization

values.label: UN/ECE
values.definition: United Nations - Economic Commission for Europe

values.label: Assigned by national trade agency
values.definition: The code list is from a national agency

values.label: GS1 France
values.definition: Organisation responsible for GS1 System in France.

values.label: GS1 Italy
values.definition: Organisation responsible for GS1 System in Italy.

values.label: CEFIC
values.definition: Conseil Europeen des Federations de l'Industrie Chimique

values.label: EDIFICE
values.definition: EDI Forum for companies with Interest in Computing and Electronics (EDI project for EDP/ADP sector).

values.label: US, National Retail Federation
values.definition: The National Retail Federation is the trade association for the general merchandise retailing industry. In addition to providing support and education services, they also maintain and publish standard colour and size codes for the retail industry.

values.label: DE, BRD

values.label: Destroy for Credit
values.definition: Trading partner documents and subsequently destroys defective, damaged, or otherwise non-saleable goods and is issued a credit for the material by the other trading partner.

values.label: Destroy No Credit
values.definition: Indicates that in case a product is damaged, defective, or not-sellable it can be returned to the supplier. The supplier will then destroy the item and doesn’t give the consumer any money back (i.e.: an old copier).

values.label: Full

values.label: Hold for Inspection

values.label: No Policy

values.label: Partial
values.definition: The manufacturer has indicated the return policy can only be for a partial shipment of the merchandise received by the retailer.

values.label: Possible Cover Return
values.definition: Instead of returning the entire unsold book or periodical, the trading partner can return the cover or allowable part of the periodical.

values.label: Return for Credit
values.definition: Defective, damaged, or otherwise non-saleable goods are physically returned by a trading partner prior to the issuance of credit for the material.

values.label: Return Prohibited

values.label: Dark roast
values.definition: Refers to coffee beans that have been roasted for an extended period of time, resulting in a deep brown to almost black color and a robust, bold flavour profile. During the roasting process, the beans undergo chemical changes that impact their taste, aroma, and appearance.

values.label: Extra dark roast
values.definition: Refers to coffee beans that have been roasted to a very high temperature, resulting in a nearly black colour, and very oily beans; intense, charred flavours dominate with very low acidity and a syrupy, full body.

values.label: Light roast
values.definition: Refers to coffee beans that have been roasted for a shorter period of time and at lower temperatures compared to dark roast beans. This type of roast preserves more of the original flavours and characteristics of the coffee beans, resulting in a lighter color and a more nuanced flavour profile.

values.label: Medium dark roast
values.definition: Refers to coffee beans that falls between the spectrum of medium and dark roast coffee, resulting in rich brown beans with slight oil; deeper flavours like chocolate and spice, lower acidity, and a fuller body.

values.label: Medium roast
values.definition: Refers to coffee beans that falls between the spectrum of light and dark roast coffee. It aims to strike a balance between preserving the natural flavours of the coffee beans and developing some of the richer, caramelized notes associated with darker roasts. Medium roast coffee is often sought after for its versatility and ability to showcase both the bean's origin characteristics and roasting nuances.

values.label: Other

values.label: Unroasted
values.definition: Refers to coffee beans that have not yet undergone the roasting process. These beans are typically small, hard, green or yellowish in color, and they lack the familiar aromas and flavours associated with roasted coffee. Also known as green coffee.

values.label: Dried heavy salted
values.definition: After the final production process is completed, the salt content of the finished product is relatively heavy and moisture content is significantly reduced. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, this is less than 33% of the dry weight of the fish and the fish has a maximum moisture content of 54%, known as "Dried heavy salted fish").

values.label: Extra heavy salted
values.definition: After the final production process is completed, the salt content of the finished product is relatively heavy, but the moisture content is not significantly reduced (e.g. in Canada, this is greater than 33% of the dry weight of the fish and the fish has a moisture content of between 54% and 65%, known as "Green heavy salted fish").

values.label: Extra light salted
values.definition: After the final production process is completed, the salt content of the finished product is relatively very low.  The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, this is a maximum of 25% of the dry weight of the fish, known as "Slack salted fish").

values.label: Light salted
values.definition: After the final production process is completed, the salt content of the finished product is relatively light/low. The determination of this is made by the supplier and is subject to target market regulations or trade organisation guidelines (e.g. in Canada, this is more than 25% but not more than 33% of the dry weight of the fish, known as "Light salted fish").
